newsitem.title: JAPAN: SANKYO SEIKI BID-ONLY ON EARNINGS F'CAST REVISION.
newsitem.headline: SANKYO SEIKI BID-ONLY ON EARNINGS F'CAST REVISION.

text.p: Shares of Sankyo Seiki Mfg Co Ltd were bid-only on Wednesday morning due to an earnings forecast revision the company announced on Tuesday, traders said.
Sankyo Seiki shares were bid-only at 867 yen at midday against Tuesday's close of 817 yen.
The company makes music boxes and electronic components.
On Tuesday, Sankyo Seiki raised its parent current profit forecast for the six months to September 30 to 2.60 billion yen from its previous interim current profit forecast of 1.50 billion yen.
The company also raised its parent and group earnings forecasts for the full year to March 31, 1998.
